constructor.signature: constructor(address checkpoint, address controller, uint64 maxGrowth)

args.name: checkpoint
args.note: Testnet checkpoint address. The owner sets the real value at deploy time. This pack holds no key.

args.name: controller
args.note: Example address used only for the code-hash preview. The deployed controller is a Safe proxy: SafeL2 1.4.1 singleton, threshold 2, three owners. The owner creates that Safe outside this repo.

args.name: maxGrowth
args.note: ChitAnchor.DEFAULT_MAX_GROWTH. Most new leaves one anchor may append. The runtime code hash depends on this value. Tiers today are 128 lines an hour and are moving toward 256. One million is about four thousand 256-line hours.
